sourceReference.referenceNote: Modeled from the viral Roast Me YouTube Short (https://www.youtube.com/shorts/nCVTDHdV7gA). Implements faithful vector recreations of Twitter/X social post cards and dynamic iOS iMessage cards over continuous gameplay. v0.2.0 introduces the animated PNGtuber / 2D avatar presenter extension modeled directly from SpecularAction (https://www.youtube.com/@SpecularAction/shorts).
